# 二、长期合作与异常阶段识别表

> 注：本表为“二、长期合作与异常阶段识别表”。原表第 25 行 C 列表头为空，根据列内容（邮件类型/动作）补为“邮件类型/动作”。

| 邮件类型/动作 | 阶段 | 邮件模板/典型主题 | 商务信息关键词 | 联系方式关键词 | 履约信息关键词 | 其他关键字段 | 使用场景说明 | 优先级 | 交付状态 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 联盟项目邀请 | Affiliate开通 | Join the LiTime Affiliate Program | affiliate; commission; Impact; referral program; affiliate rate; performance partnership | affiliate email; PayPal; account email | affiliate link; tracking link; coupon code; attribution window; dashboard | sign-up link; commission rate; payment cycle | 将一次性红人合作转化为长期联盟合作 | 中 | 已整理 | Affiliate开通不等于已经产生订单 |
| 联盟信息配置 | Affiliate配置中 | Your LiTime Affiliate Link and Creator Code | commission rate; discount rate; qualified order; payout | Impact account email; affiliate account | tracking link; creator code; coupon; landing page; UTM | attribution; cookie window; code priority; testing order | 红人已经加入平台，正在配置链接、Code和归因规则 | 高 | 已整理 | 必须检查Code和链接是否可以正常追踪 |
| 素材授权确认 | 授权确认 | LiTime Content Usage Permission Confirmation | usage fee; licensing fee; paid usage; organic usage | rights contact; agency; legal contact | content usage; whitelisting; paid ads; website; social media; EDM; raw footage | usage period; territory; editing rights; perpetual; exclusivity | 品牌希望将红人素材用于官网、广告、社媒或EDM | 高 | 已整理 | 免费自然使用和付费广告授权必须分开识别 |
| 复投邀请邮件 | 二次合作 | New LiTime Collaboration Opportunity | new campaign; repeat collaboration; long-term partnership; new product; returning creator | previous contact; account manager | new deliverables; new sample; previous product; new timeline | previous GMV; ROI; views; content quality; historical rate | 历史合作表现较好，邀请红人参与新品或下一轮合作 | 中 | 已整理 | 应关联历史合作记录和表现 |
| 合作延期邮件 | 延期风险 | Update on the Content Timeline | delay; postponed; need more time; reschedule; unable to publish; unexpected issue; family emergency | best follow-up contact | new date; delayed shipment; filming delay; editing delay; revised schedule | reason; original deadline; new deadline; recovery plan | 红人因物流、天气、家庭或制作问题无法按时发布 | 高 | 已整理 | 私人突发情况应进入关怀型处理，不直接判定违约 |
| 修改未完成 | 内容风险 | Follow-Up on Requested Content Updates | revision pending; changes not completed; missing update; incorrect information | editor; content manager | revision deadline; missing code; incorrect link; product claim issue | outstanding items; second revision; approval blocked | 红人未按反馈完成修改，影响发布或验收 | 高 | 已整理 | 需要Agent提醒负责人继续跟进 |
| 失联跟进 | 失联风险 | Following Up on Our LiTime Collaboration | no response; checking in; follow-up; haven’t heard back; just wanted to reconnect | alternative email; WhatsApp; agency contact | outstanding deliverable; sample received; deadline passed | days since last reply; follow-up count; risk level | 红人长时间不回复，合作可能停滞 | 高 | 已整理 | 失联不能只靠关键词判断，还要结合最后回复日期 |
| 合作拒绝 | 已拒绝 | Re: Collaboration Opportunity | not interested; unable to collaborate; pass; decline; not a fit; fully booked; no availability | manager; agency | declined product; unavailable timeline | reason for rejection; future possibility | 红人明确拒绝本次合作 | 中 | 已整理 | “Not available now but open later”应标记为暂缓，不是永久拒绝 |
| 合作暂停 | 暂缓/待重启 | Collaboration on Hold | on hold; pause; revisit later; not available this month; future opportunity | future contact; follow-up month | new timeline; product return; campaign postponed | restart date; reason; owner | 双方暂时不继续，但未来可能重启 | 中 | 已整理 | 建议设置自动提醒时间 |
| 合作终止 | 已关闭 | LiTime Collaboration Closure | cancel; terminate; cancellation; refund; return product; no longer proceed | legal contact; return contact | return label; return tracking; refund status; product status | termination reason; liability; closure date | 双方确定不再继续本次合作 | 高 | 已整理 | 终止后仍要检查样品、费用和素材是否处理完毕 |
